title: Who will be named Player of the Tournament at the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
background: The Player of the Tournament award recognizes an individual player's performance across the competition.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The International Cricket Council's official announcement of the Player of the Tournament for the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve when the recipient of the tournament-wide award is officially announced, rather than any individual match award. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The recipient's full name.
